title: 个人课表、考试与成绩只读适配
worktree_note: The contract privacy validator rejects absolute home-directory paths, so the worktree is recorded relative to the user home.
batch_state: 4.1 accepted on its module branch; batch 4 has no integration commit yet
outputs: academics-read-v1: three read-only capabilities, blocked production entry (UNKNOWN + ADAPTER_REQUIRED + zero items) and a synthetic-only rehearsal path
semester selection by source id; equal titles with different ids stay separate; no near-title merge
course association by source course id or teaching class; title-only association returns candidates but never a course_uid
timetable entry model retains weeks, parity, weekday, periods, date range, room, platform time, teaching class and attempt
week-expansion-v1: explicit school calendar and period table only; holidays, makeup days, replacement dates and out-of-term weeks are explicit; missing inputs keep the raw cycle
exam model retains id, course association, date, start/end, room, seat, time precision, state, release state and coverage
grade-v1 output distinguishes GRADED, UNGRADED, WITHHELD and UNKNOWN; zero is GRADED; level and pass/fail grades stay textual; no GPA or rank
exam-event-v1 and timetable-event-v1 converters to calendar-event-v1; grades are refused
academics-grade-privacy-v1: counts-only audit, dashboard exclusion, explicit model context, encrypted-cache requirement
operation_schemas and capability report for the future 6.1 registration
accepted_cases: same-title courses in different semesters and different teaching classes keep distinct course and entry identities; no title-based merge
odd, even, holiday, makeup-day and out-of-term weeks follow the explicit calendar; a missing period table leaves clock times null
missing calendar keeps the raw week pattern and produces no dates
date-only exams keep TIME DATE and no midnight; cancelled, rescheduled, makeup and deferred exams keep separate states
ungraded, withheld and zero grades remain distinct and are never converted into each other
a failed second page keeps the first-page rows and reduces source completeness; a failure is never EMPTY
grade audit, public summary and default model context never contain grade values; an explicit request and purpose are required
a blocked capability returns UNKNOWN with ADAPTER_REQUIRED, no items and no simulated record; non-synthetic transports are refused
a page-number gap is PARTIAL with missing_pages [2], never a complete source
a partial expansion still converts every valid occurrence and returns skipped dates
scope=COURSE applies the exact course filter, limit truncation is visible and reported, and an unsupported scope is rejected
an end time without a start time is rejected before any date branch
a malformed exam time makes the event converter fail closed instead of emitting time=null
missing timetable/exam record ids get deterministic TEMPORARY_SCOPED identities; titles never participate
limits: All three production adapters remain blocked by missing source evidence; no real timetable, exam or grade read was performed.
Timetable entries and exams are module-local shapes because no frozen schema exists; their identity rule is documented and must be registered by 2.3 before becoming a public model.
grade-v1 has additionalProperties=false and no temporary identity slot, so a grade without a source record id stays MISSING_STABLE_ID; only timetable and exam records receive TEMPORARY_SCOPED ids.
grade-v1 also cannot carry a check time or derivation marker; the envelope carries checked_at and the record keeps source_evidence_id.
Source coverage must be declared by the transport; undeclared coverage keeps complete=false and, for exams, adds EXAM_COVERAGE_NOT_DECLARED.
calendar-event-v1 has no ACADEMICS service domain, so converted events use service_domain=UNKNOWN; 5.4 may map it when consuming.
The privacy module defines policy; no encrypted cache backend is wired here. Callers must use the encrypted store and must call the audit/dashboard helpers.

The 11 module error codes are not in the frozen error-classification contract because contracts/v0.2 is outside 4.1's exclusive paths; errors.classification_map()/classify() is the bridge and 2.3/6.1 own registration.
No query registry, MCP tool, todos.py, source registry or batch gate was modified; 6.1 and the integration owner own those steps.
Offline synthetic evidence only; no live campus login, read, booking, payment or submission.
rollback: Delete src/thu_assistant/academics/, tests/test_academics.py and tests/fixtures/academics/. No frozen contract, query registry, MCP tool or batch record changes, so old clients and the previous batches are unaffected. Pending cursors or caches do not exist for this module.
cross_module_requests: 6.1: register timetable, exams and grades read operations from operation_schemas(), keep the explicit-request gate for grades and enrich the MCP error boundary with the classified shape.
5.4: consume calendar_events('exams'|'timetable'); respect DATE vs DATE_TIME, TENTATIVE/CONFIRMED derivation and the excluded list; grades are never events.
6.2/7.1: public dashboard summaries must call sensitivity.dashboard_summary and must not read grade values.
2.3/integration: only after sanitized source evidence arrives, update source-registry.json and adapter-readiness.json, then change CAPABILITIES to IMPLEMENTED and wire a production transport.
4.2/4.3: reuse domain_models and source_state instead of re-deriving identity or completeness.

fixed.P1-1: collect_pages fills the integer page range and records a gap as missing; pages 1+3 now yield PARTIAL, source_complete=false, missing_pages=[2].
fixed.P1-2: holiday/makeup/date-range skips are normal and keep EXPANDED; timetable_events converts any expansion with occurrences and returns skipped, with PARTIAL_EXPANSION only for an anomalous partial.
fixed.P1-3: scope=COURSE requires course, exact course_id/teaching_class_id/title filtering runs before normalization, limit truncates items and is reported in read_scope/truncated/RESULT_LIMIT_REACHED; scope=ALL was removed.
fixed.P1-4: END_WITHOUT_START is checked before the date/precision branch, so a lone end_time fails closed.
fixed.P2-1: exam warnings are merged instead of reset; an invalid date keeps EXAM_DATE_INVALID.
fixed.P2-2: makeup days only join a selected week or replace a natural date; date_range bounds occurrences with OUTSIDE_DECLARED_RANGE; calendar/period-table semesters must agree even without an explicit semester.
fixed.P2-3: first_value() skips null/blank primaries across semester dates, weekday, parity, week range, exam date/state/release and grade value/scale/state.
fixed.P2-4: event record ids reuse the existing stable/temporary UID or <source>:<record> without lossy rewriting; equal event_uids become EVENT_UID_CONFLICT.
fixed.P2-5: exam_event raises ACADEMICS_EVENT_UNSUPPORTED when calendar_time returns null and _base rejects a non-object time.
fixed.P2-6: semesters without a title stay selectable by id with SEMESTER_TITLE_MISSING; semester/course support-row rejections add warnings and reduce completeness.
fixed.P2-7: transport exceptions normalize to AcademicsError/ACADEMICS_ERROR without their text; classification_map()/classify() provide typed categories before frozen-contract registration; three unused codes were removed.
fixed.P2-8: record counts refreshed to the actual outputs (98 module tests, 422 files, Python 746/7, Node 66).
fixed.P2-9: missing timetable/exam record ids receive deterministic TEMPORARY_SCOPED ids without titles and can be converted to events; grade-v1 cannot carry a temporary slot, so grades stay MISSING_STABLE_ID.
